items.title: BJP, PM Modi Offering Free Recharge On Returning To Power? A Fact Check
items.snippet_en: Multiple social media posts claiming PM Modi and BJP are offering free mobile recharge for three months are fake. Neither BJP nor PM Modi is offering any such scheme, and clicking unknown links may lead to spam, phishing, or data theft.

items.title: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results, here's the truth
items.snippet_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has clarified that the government or PM Modi is not running any scheme offering free mobile recharge, debunking viral posts claiming otherwise after the Lok Sabha election results.

items.title: PM Modi Launching 'Free Recharge Yojana' for 2024 Polls? No, It's a Hoax
items.snippet_en: A fake post claiming PM Modi is offering free Rs 239 recharge to voters ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections is a hoax. The linked website collects user data and could lead to financial scams.

items.title: Central Government: केंद्र सरकार सभी यूजर्स को दे रही 3 महीने का फ्री रिचार्ज, जल्दी से जानिए क्या है सच?
items.snippet_en: A viral message claiming the Indian government is giving 3 months of free recharge was found to be false by PIB Fact Check.

items.title: PM Modi 3-Month Free Recharge: Real or Fake? || Sambad
items.snippet_en: A viral video claiming PM Modi is offering a free 3-month mobile recharge is labeled as a "dangerous trap" and "FakeNewsAlert" by Sambad.

items.title: Govt debunks fake video claiming PM Modi announced free three-month recharge
items.snippet_en: The government has debunked a video circulating on social media claiming PM Modi announced a free three-month recharge for all citizens. The PIB Fact Check Unit confirmed the claim is fake and the video is AI-generated.
